content: Shortly after, lstm-minusconstituency use the same method on the task of constituency parsing, as the representation of a sentence span, extending the original uni-directional LSTM-Minus to the bi-directional case. More recently, inspired by the success of LSTM-Minus in both dependency and constituency parsing, lstm-minusdiscourse extend the technique to discourse parsing. They propose a two-stage model consisting of an intra-sentential parser and a multi-sentential parser, learning contextually informed representations of constituents with LSTM-Minus, at the sentence and document level, respectively.
